swap_risks: CRITICAL PACKAGE MISMATCH: TPS61023DRLR uses SOT-563 (6-pin, DRL) while TPS613221ADBVR uses SOT-23-5 (5-pin, DBV); PCB footprint redesign is mandatory.

CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 1 (FB vs SW), Pin 2 (EN vs GND), Pin 3 (VIN vs NC), Pin 4 (GND vs VOUT), Pin 5 (SW vs NC), Pin 6 (VOUT vs NONE). Soldering TPS613221ADBVR onto a TPS61023DRLR footprint (or vice versa) without rerouting copper can short VIN/VOUT/GND and permanently damage the board.

CRITICAL FEEDBACK LAYOUT DIFFERENCE: One converter is fixed-output while the other is adjustable; adding or removing the external R1/R2 feedback divider and feedforward capacitor requires a PCB layout change.

HIGH SWITCHING FREQUENCY SHIFT: fsw differs by 38% (TPS61023DRLR: 1000 kHz p.5 vs TPS613221ADBVR: 1600 kHz p.9); re-evaluate inductor core loss, ripple current ΔIL, output capacitor ESR ripple, and EMI harmonics.
CAUTION INDUCTOR RETUNING: Typical inductor differs (TPS61023DRLR: 1 µH p.4 vs TPS613221ADBVR: 2.2 µH p.4); check inductor Isat against peak switch current limit.

CAUTION CURRENT RATING BASIS: TPS61023DRLR specifies 3700 mA (switch current limit Isw, p.5) vs TPS613221ADBVR 1200 mA (switch current limit Isw, p.5). Remember boost/switch-limited Iout,max is strictly less than Isw due to duty-cycle and inductor ripple scaling.
HIGH THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA is 33% higher on TPS613221ADBVR (TPS61023DRLR: 142.7 °C/W p.4 vs TPS613221ADBVR: 189.7 °C/W p.4); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.
engineering_verdict: TPS61023DRLR (Texas Instruments, SOT-563) and TPS613221ADBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) are NOT drop-in interchangeable (Level 3 PCB Layout / Circuit Change Required) due to package/footprint mismatch; pinout mismatch on Pin 1 (FB vs SW), Pin 2 (EN vs GND), Pin 3 (VIN vs NC), Pin 4 (GND vs VOUT), Pin 5 (SW vs NC), Pin 6 (VOUT vs NONE); fixed vs adjustable output feedback footprint mismatch (R1/R2 divider). Specific pin conflicts: Pin 1 (FB vs SW), Pin 2 (EN vs GND), Pin 3 (VIN vs NC), Pin 4 (GND vs VOUT). Power-stage deltas: boost (sync) vs boost (sync), switching frequency 1000 kHz (p.5) vs 1600 kHz (p.9) (1.6x ratio), typical inductor 1 µH (p.4) vs 2.2 µH (p.4), output mode adjustable vs fixed, and package θJA 142.7 vs 189.7 °C/W. Primary bench gotchas to watch: TPS61023DRLR "1.8 V Minimum Startup Voltage Despite 0.5 V Running Floor" (p.5) and TPS613221ADBVR "No Enable (EN) Pin and No True Load Disconnect" (p.3). BOM decision: Choose TPS61023DRLR when higher switch current capacity (3700 mA) is required; choose TPS613221ADBVR when light-load battery standby needs 6.5 µA Iq. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.3 vs TOP_VIEW p.3) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
